sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: You have got to be kidding me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exasperated and incredulous, with a sharp burst of frustration at the bad luck of being delayed on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... move already.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s impatient and stressed from being delayed on the very first day, with a frustrated urgency that’s turning into a determined push to get moving.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. It's fine. New term, fresh start, and I'm sweating before homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to talk herself into staying upbeat, but underneath the joking words she feels flustered, stressed, and embarrassed about already being in a mess on the first day.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and urgently determined, pushing through the crowd with embarrassed energy while trying to stay upbeat and not let the bad start rattle her.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: Breathless and relieved after a frantic rush, with a burst of triumphant optimism that she still managed to arrive in time.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She freezes in sudden embarrassment and awkward surprise, realizing she has burst into the wrong room and is now painfully aware of everyone staring at her.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from realizing she rushed into the wrong classroom, but still trying to recover quickly and sound composed.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Right! Great! Love that for me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and embarrassed by the mistake, but is forcing a bright, joking front to save face and keep from spiraling.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from barging into the wrong classroom, but trying to recover with upbeat, socially smooth confidence.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously? You may have just saved my life.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels intensely relieved and grateful, with a burst of embarrassed humor as she clings to the small rescue after a chaotic, humiliating morning.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Here! Present. Very present. Extremely sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed from her string of mistakes, but is trying to recover with upbeat, self-aware humor and a determined effort to make a good impression.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: I can't believe that happened before nine in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and exasperated, but mostly relieved and amused at how absurdly badly the morning started.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Recovered? I entered the wrong class like I was making a dramatic entrance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s embarrassed but laughing it off with self-deprecating humor, trying to turn a mortifying mistake into something playful and confident.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Then I'll call it confidence and not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s joking herself back into composure, turning embarrassment into playful self-assurance while still feeling the sting of the morning’s blunders.
sprite_sequence.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

sprite_sequence.text: Hey, since I already embarrassed myself in front of half the first years... want to stick together at lunch?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels relieved and warmly embarrassed, but is now turning that shared awkwardness into an upbeat, friendly bid for companionship and reassurance.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful
